body.name: \(\boldsymbol\tau\)
body.construction: For \(p\geq3\), fix the ordered injection \(\iota:\{X,Y,Z\}\hookrightarrow\{1,\ldots,p\}\) and write \(i_A=\iota(A)\) for \(A\in\{X,Y,Z\}\). For \(x\in\{1,2\}\), define \(P_{r,\theta}^{\operatorname{do}(V_{i_X}=x)}(v_{-i_X})=\prod_{s\neq i_X}p_{rs,\theta}(v_s\mid v_{\operatorname{pa}_{d_r}(s)})\big|_{v_{i_X}=x}\). Set \(\tau_{i_Y,r}=\mathbb E_{P_{r,\theta}^{\operatorname{do}(V_{i_X}=2)}}[V_{i_Y}]-\mathbb E_{P_{r,\theta}^{\operatorname{do}(V_{i_X}=1)}}[V_{i_Y}]\), \(\tau_{i_Z,r}=\mathbb E_{P_{r,\theta}^{\operatorname{do}(V_{i_X}=2)}}[V_{i_Z}]-\mathbb E_{P_{r,\theta}^{\operatorname{do}(V_{i_X}=1)}}[V_{i_Z}]\), and \(\boldsymbol\tau=((\tau_{i_Y,r},\tau_{i_Z,r}))_{r=1}^{K}\).
